content: Faraón-ulale, nunmak-itoged
Deunni, anmar birgambe-gakabogus gaka nii-warambe-gakabogwad-ibagwengus Babiloniaʼgi-bukwadgine, Bab-Jehová weyob anga sokalid:
“Dule-machi, Egipto-rey-Faraónʼga, we-wile-itoged-namaklegedgi be namake:

content.text: Be-naggi, dii gudure be imaked, e-sukemar binnasur-nakwamaksii be saed.’ ”

content: A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, weyob soged:

content.text: an-saki an begi mioed, agi an be-gaoed.
Be burgwenonikile, negsichidbi-nai nibneg an imakoed,
Be-ulale, bela nibneggi niis-dummagan-gananaidi, ginnega an imakoed.
Deginbali, bergusye be-wisgumaloedbali, bukidar neggweburmargi dobed-dummad-naguega an imakbaloed.
Amarga an-es-suid an oyodele, e-reymar gwayidmaloed.
Amar Egipto-dulemar na san-dummarba-imakdiid obelogoed, bela Egipto-dulemar galakuoed.
we-diwarmar bar dulemarse, degi, ibmar-durganse gudure guosulid.
Geb degine, diimar an diree mesoed,
‘Egipto-yar, nega-dulesulidganga an imaksale, an e-ibe bela ibmar-nikad obergusale,
degi, e-dulemar an bela ogilosale, geb wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.’

content: ”Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad Egiptoʼga, degi, e-dulemarga we-wile-itoged-namaklegedgi namakmaloed. ”Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged.”
Deunni, anmar birgambe-gakabogus gaka nii-warambe-gakabogwad-ibatargus, Babiloniaʼgi-bukwadgine, Bab-Jehová weyob anga sokalid:
“Dule-machi, Egipto-dulemarga-wile-itoged-namaklegedgi be namake, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-e-dulemar bur gandikidmaladba, napa-uluba-burgwar-mamaidse be odoge.
Ese be egise: ‘¿Ar bemar bamalad-dulemarba bur yeerdaklege? Emigindi, Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad-abargi, be napa-uluba-dogsa megmala.’
Dulemar-es-suidgi-burgwismalad-abargi burgwemarmogoed. Es-suid bato argangi ganimalad, Egipto-yar, degi, bela e-dulemar bergumaloed.

Dulemar-bila-onoged bur dutusurmaladi, bur gandikmaladi, napa-uluba-dulemar-burgwar-mamaidgi, Egipto-dulemargi, degi, eba-nanaimaladgi sunmakmaloed. Weyob sogmaloed: ‘¡Bato napa-uluba dogsamala! Dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad-es-suidgi-burgwismalad-abargi mellemamai.’
”Agi Asiria-dorgan maid, e-neg-uan-ebiris bela e-sordaganbo maid. Bela wemar es-suidgi burgwismalad.
Bela we-napneggi dulemar-ogwayedigusmaladi burgwar-mamaid, es-suidgi burgwismalad. Emigindi, napa-uluba digles mamaid, Asiria-e-neg-uan-dikarba mamaid.

”Agi Elam maid, e-neg-uan-ebiris bela e-sordaganbo maid. Bela wemar es-suidgi burgwismalad. Bela we-napneggi dulemar-ogwayedii gusmalad, Bab-Dummad-akudakmaladyob napa-uluba odoles mamaid. Napa-uluba burgwismamaid-abargi, dule-nugsulidyob mamaid.

Elamʼga, Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad-es-suidgi-burgwismalad-abargi gas nasiksamalad. Emidi, Elam-e-neg-uan-dikarba mamaid. We-burgwismalad we-napneggi dulemar-ogwayedii gusmalad. Ar emigindi, napa-uluba burgwismamaid-abargi dule-nugsulidyob mamaid. Agi dulemar-gindaklesmalad-abargi megismalad.
”Agi Mesec, degi, Tubal maid, e-neg-uan-ebiris e-sordaganbo maid. Bela wemar Bab-Dummad-akudakmaladid, es-suidgi oburgwilesmaladid, ar ade, we-napneggi dulemar-ogwayedii gusmalad.

Mesec, degi, Tubal, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudaked-e-dule-bulegan-abargi diglessurmalad. We-dule-bulegandi bila-onosadgi e-gingimar-ebusad-gani, degi, e-nono-urba es-suid-mai diglesmalad. We-dule-bulegan we-napneggi dulemar-ogwayedigusmarsoggu, amba burgwisad-sorba, e-isgusad-ulale, e-garmar sabsur-imaklesad.
”Agi be, Egipto, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad-abargi be bergus megoed, dulemar-es-suidgi-burgwismaladba be diglegoed.

”Agi Edom e-reymarmala, degi, e-dummaganmala maid. Ar amba bela-bela gangued-nika-inigwele, amar dulemar-es-suidgi-burgwismalad-abargi digar-mamaimogad. Dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad-abargi, napa-uluba digles mamaid.

”Agi dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsikid-e-dummagan, degi, bela Sidónʼginmalad maid. Na e-gangued-nikadba dulemar-ogwayedigusmar-inigwele, wemar dulemar-es-suidgi-burgwismaladba dule-nugsulidyob napa-uluba dogsa maimarmogad. Wemar, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmaladid. Emigindi, dulemar-es-suidgi-burgwismalad-abargi, napa-uluba digles mamaimogad.
”Ar Faraón wemar-dakalile, geb na e-sordamar-burgwismaladba wile-itodiid berguoed, ar ade, Faraón e-sordamarmala es-suidgi burgwismalad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged.

”Ar we-napneggi, dulemar-ogwayega, an Faraón-imaksa-inigwele, Faraón e-sordamarmala dulemar-Bab-Dummad-akudakmalad-es-suidgi-burgwismalad-abargi, diglemarmogoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob soged.”
